title: SMO event envelope
description: One event of the SMO's event bus (PR-MSG-3, docs/EVENTS.md): a CloudEvents 1.0 event in its JSON form, with three extension attributes. smo_shared/events.py builds it; GET /dme/smo-events answers a list of them.

id.description: Unique per event; a reader that sees an id twice has seen the same event.

source.description: The module that published it, as /smo/<module>.

subject.description: The entity the event is about (its id); absent when it has none.

time.description: When the module published it (its transaction's time, UTC).

smoseq.description: The event's position in the feed: what a reader passes as `after` to read on.

smoregion.description: The region of the managed element the event is about, when it is one's.

smotenant.description: The tenant of that element, when it has one.
